s01_01.text: Hello, friends! Today we look at the weather!

s01_02.text: Beep beep! Look up at the sky!

s03_02.text: On a sunny day, we wear a hat.

s05_02.text: The clouds are hiding the sun.

s06_01.text: How many clouds can you see?

s08_01.text: Can you blow like the wind?

s09_01.text: Quack! My kite flies in the wind!

s10_02.text: Drip, drop. The rain is falling.

s12_02.text: Can you jump in a puddle?

s13_02.text: That is thunder. It is only a loud sound.

s13_03.text: Boom! Let's get in the bus!

s14_02.text: We are warm and dry in the bus!

s16_01.text: Sun and rain together make a...

s17_01.text: It is rainy. Do we take a hat or an umbrella?

s18_01.text: Hello, friends! The sky is clear tonight.

s18_02.text: We can see all the stars!

s22_01.text: Sunny: the sun shines. Cloudy: the clouds hide the sun.

s22_02.text: Windy: the wind blows. Rainy: drip, drop. Thunder: boom!

s22_03.text: And after the rain, a rainbow!

s23_01.text: Thank you for watching the weather with us!

s23_02.text: Beep beep! Time to go home!

s24_01.text: Sunny or rainy, every day is a good day!
